properties.title: OpenStreetMap offshore wind infrastructure, Polish Baltic (2026-10-27 snapshot)
properties.description: Dated GeoJSON snapshot of offshore wind related OpenStreetMap features in the Polish Baltic. The 292 features comprise 287 Points, 4 Polygons, and 1 feature with null geometry. OSM feature properties retain osm_type, osm_id, and the source tags object; records include generators/turbines, substations and wind-farm areas, so the collection is not exclusively a farm inventory.
properties.coverage_note: Source description says offshore Polish Baltic, latitude greater than 54.85; exact request bounds and feature-selection query are not recorded, so completeness cannot be assessed. start_datetime and end_datetime express the UTC calendar-day bounds for the date-only snapshot, not actual retrieval timestamps.

data.title: Polish Baltic offshore wind OSM snapshot GeoJSON
data.description: Source GeoJSON FeatureCollection; each feature preserves the OSM object type and ID and its original tags. Relation members are retained where present.
